description: Post a new comment on a task. Optionally assign it to a user and notify all watchers. Returns the created comment's id. Use to leave feedback, ask questions or record an update directly on a task.

assignee.description: User ID to assign this comment to, turning it into an actionable item for that person.

comment_text.description: The comment body text (plain text or ClickUp markdown).

custom_task_ids.description: Set true when `task_id` is a custom task ID instead of a native ClickUp ID. Requires `team_id`.

notify_all.description: If true, notify everyone with access to the task; if false/omitted, only the assignee is notified.

task_id.description: ID of the task to comment on.

team_id.description: Team/Workspace ID. Falls back to CLICKUP_TEAM_ID when omitted.

name: create_task_comment
